base.title: GameScience Base
base.purpose: Provider, token foundations, utilities, and shared types.

theme-gamescience.title: GameScience Theme
theme-gamescience.purpose: House theme CSS for GameScience applications.
useWhen: using the default GameScience visual identity
avoid: mixing with citadel in the same screen

theme-citadel.title: Citadel Theme
theme-citadel.purpose: Citadel 4.1 HUD theme CSS with semantic tokens and theme-scoped treatments — no component forks. Font stacks only; load fonts at the application level (see docs/font-loading.md).
avoid: creating CitadelButton or other theme-named forks
installing alongside theme-gamescience as concurrent nested themes

button.title: Button
button.purpose: Semantic button primitive with intent, size, emphasis, and loading states.
useWhen: primary and secondary actions across all contexts
avoid: passing theme or glass/neon visual props

input.title: Input
input.purpose: Text input primitive with invalid-state support.

panel.title: Panel
panel.purpose: Surface container with semantic elevation and emphasis.
useWhen: grouping related content on a surface

badge.title: Badge
badge.purpose: Compact status and metadata label with semantic intent and treatment axes.

alert.title: Alert
alert.purpose: Inline status messaging with icons and titles.
avoid: using alerts for transient toast notifications — use Sonner

progress.title: Progress
useWhen: showing lobby fill or round completion
avoid: encoding game scoring logic in the component

game-code-input.title: Game Code Input
game-code-input.purpose: Room/session code field with validation messaging.
avoid: embedding networking validation inside the component

connection-status.title: Connection Status
useWhen: showing connected, reconnecting, or offline state

participant-identity.title: Participant Identity
avoid: storing identity persistence inside the component

participant-status.title: Participant Status
participant-status.purpose: Connection and readiness summary for a participant.
avoid: showing private role information on shared display

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.purpose: Semantic elapsed or remaining time display. Does not calculate time — pass a formatted value.
useWhen: showing stage timers or remaining time in headers and HUDs
avoid: passing raw seconds and deriving warning thresholds inside the component

phase-progress.title: Phase Progress
phase-progress.purpose: Discrete phase or step progression without owning the game phase model.
useWhen: communicating ordered phase steps across facilitator or display surfaces
avoid: replacing linear Progress for continuous values

connection-banner.title: Connection Banner
connection-banner.purpose: Significant connection interruption banner. Complements compact ConnectionStatus and blocking WaitingState.
useWhen: surfacing reconnecting, disconnected, or restored connection across a surface
avoid: replacing compact ConnectionStatus for inline badges
preferOver: duplicating Alert solely for connection chrome
deprecatedAlternatives: duplicating Alert solely for connection chrome

phase-header.title: Phase Header
phase-header.purpose: Compact participant/game surface header with eyebrow, phase pill, and trailing status slots.
useWhen: participant operational headers with phase and timer regions
avoid: putting instructional body copy in the header

phase-directive.title: Phase Directive
phase-directive.purpose: Current-task instruction or phase guidance with plain, strip, or panel treatments.
useWhen: showing the current participant or facilitator task instruction

role-panel.title: Role Panel
role-panel.purpose: Participant role summary with optional priorities disclosure, identity slot, and private objective.
useWhen: presenting a resolved participant role summary
avoid: shipping avatar scanners or radar as registry deps

vote-status.title: Vote Status
vote-status.purpose: Aggregate voting progress without owning vote logic. Auto mode uses pips for small rooms.
useWhen: showing how many votes are in without revealing identities

outcome-summary.title: Outcome Summary
outcome-summary.purpose: High-level outcome, description, optional metrics and actions. Does not own outcome taxonomy.
useWhen: summarising round or session outcomes with semantic intent
avoid: encoding game outcome keys such as optimal or catastrophic
passing participant-private metrics on shared display

sticky-action-bar.title: Sticky Action Bar
sticky-action-bar.purpose: Mobile participant action region anchored to the bottom of the active surface.
useWhen: participant bottom action regions with optional status row
avoid: using fixed positioning without shell compensation

room-code-display.title: Room Code Display
useWhen: showing a join code on shared displays or facilitator consoles
avoid: pairing with private participant details on shared display

display-heading.title: Display Heading
display-heading.purpose: Large shared-display heading with optional eyebrow.
useWhen: titling shared-display screens at distance-readable scale
avoid: using as a participant mobile page title without need

participant-count-display.title: Participant Count Display
participant-count-display.purpose: Privacy-safe connected participant count for shared displays.
useWhen: showing aggregate join progress on a shared display
avoid: listing private participant identities on shared display

join-flow.title: Participant Join Flow
join-flow.purpose: Participant code entry, identity, waiting, and reconnect states.
useWhen: creating a participant game joining experience
collecting a room code and participant identity
avoid: adding networking logic inside the pattern
preferOver: manually assembling a room-code form from primitives
deprecatedAlternatives: manually assembling a room-code form from primitives

lobby.title: Facilitator Lobby
lobby.purpose: Facilitator lobby with room code, participant status, and start controls.
avoid: owning stage-transition authority inside the pattern

shared-display-lobby.title: Shared Display Lobby
shared-display-lobby.purpose: Privacy-safe shared-display lobby with room code and join progress.
useWhen: broadcasting a join/lobby state on a shared room display

participant-shell.title: Participant Shell
avoid: putting facilitator density into this shell

facilitator-shell.title: Facilitator Shell
avoid: encoding session orchestration in the shell

form.title: Form
form.purpose: React Hook Form field helpers with accessible labelling.
useWhen: React Hook Form field helpers with accessible labelling.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.purpose: Date calendar primitive powered by react-day-picker. Compose with Popover for a date picker.
useWhen: Date calendar primitive powered by react-day-picker.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.purpose: Modal dialog primitive with portal content.
useWhen: Modal dialog primitive with portal content.

command.title: Command
command.purpose: Command palette / combobox list primitive (cmdk). Compose with Popover for combobox patterns.

separator.title: Separator
separator.purpose: Visual content separator with optional hairline treatment.
useWhen: hairline dividers in role and summary panels

card.title: Card
card.purpose: Composable card surface for content grouping. Prefer Panel for GameScience shell surfaces when elevation semantics matter.
useWhen: Composable card surface for content grouping.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.purpose: User/entity avatar with image and fallback.
useWhen: User/entity avatar with image and fallback.

sonner.title: Sonner
sonner.purpose: Canonical toast notification surface (Sonner). Already included with base; install explicitly when needed as a discoverable item.
